paper_title: Searching for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with an 18T Magnet Haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from paper-quoted multiples of |g_KSVZ| using g_KSVZ = 3.911e-16 * (m_a/ueV) GeV^-1 (E/N=0, |E/N-1.92|=1.92)
notes: First results from the CAPP18T haloscope (18 T HTS magnet, JPC amplifier), scanning 4.7789-4.8094 GHz (19.764-19.890 ueV). Paper quotes limits as multiples of KSVZ coupling: 1.5x KSVZ for 19.764-19.771 ueV, 2.7x KSVZ for 19.772-19.863 ueV (shallow scan), 1.7x KSVZ for 19.863-19.890 ueV, all at 90% CL assuming rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and boosted Maxwell-Boltzmann halo model. Emitted values are three piecewise-flat segments converted to absolute g_agamma in GeV^-1.
